insights: Based on 5 channel seed(s); 10000 images per seed. All gains below are paired per seed against the baseline (same packet losses), so they carry no luck-of-the-draw advantage.
No low-loss penalty: the best method is never more than 0.05 dB below `jpeg2000+rs` at any erasure_rate in this sweep.
Peak gain: +5.23 dB at erasure_rate = 0 by webp+rs.
Importance sources ranked by their best scheme's mean gain over erasure_rate >= 0.35: webp+rs +0.84 dB, jpeg+rs -0.26 dB, webp_no_rs -2.59 dB, jpeg2000_no_rs -2.79 dB, jpeg_no_rs -3.77 dB.
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.4: 5th-percentile PSNR 9.22 dB (webp+rs) vs 8.49 dB (jpeg2000+rs).
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.5: 5th-percentile PSNR 9.10 dB (webp+rs) vs 8.78 dB (jpeg2000+rs).
Seed sensitivity: std across channel seeds stays below 0.3 dB everywhere.
`jpeg2000+rs` shows its steepest fall (-7.92 dB) between erasure_rate = 0.3 and 0.35 -- its cliff.
